title: Crestline Credit Card Payment Direction: Amount Sent to the Named Plan
content:
**Clause.** On the Crestline Credit Card, the part directed is the amount available to direct, all of which reaches the named plan with no share of it held back, never more than the named plan's recorded balance, rounded half up to the cent.

A plan's recorded balance is its purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and less the merchandise credits that carry its ticket number.

## The amount available to direct

Today's payments first cover the latest statement's minimum still unpaid by the payments made toward it before today (less any returned unpaid), then the fees charged for that statement and still owed, which are a late fee charged for its missed minimum and the returned payment fee charged for a payment made toward it and returned unpaid (figured for an account on which at most one payment made toward the latest statement was returned unpaid), each less any fee reversal standing against it, and then the deferred interest of a plan whose period ended since that statement closed: the assessment when one stands, or, while none stands and the plan ended with a recorded balance, the accruals recorded for it; what is left is the amount available to direct.

| Item, in the order covered | Read from the card ledger |
|---|---|
| minimum still unpaid | the latest statement's minimum less payments made toward it before today, less any of them returned |
| fees still owed | the late fee charged for that statement's missed minimum and the returned payment fee for a payment toward it, each less any reversal citing it |
| deferred interest of a plan ended since that statement closed | its assessment entry; or, with none and a recorded balance left, its accrual entries |

**The named plan** is the deferred-interest plan whose period ends last on the account, the longer plan where two end on the same day.

## How the amounts combine

Every share a rule of this schedule adds to the held share is added in full, the held share never above one; every fraction a rule takes off it is a fraction of that held share, and together they never take off more than the whole of it, so the held share is multiplied by one less their total, that total never above one; the part directed is what reaches the named plan less the held share of it, never more than the named plan's recorded balance, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Item | USD |
|---|---|
| Payments posted today | 500.00 |
| Minimum still unpaid | 62.00 |
| Fees still owed | 19.00 |
| Deferred interest of a plan ended since closing | 44.10 |
| Amount available to direct, all reaching the named plan | 374.90 |

A named plan with a recorded balance of 120.00 USD takes no more than 120.00 USD.
